label: Ghasemi et al. (2009)
units: SA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are original_table_required - the catalogue gives the equation and metadata only, with no numerical coefficients - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Ghasemi et al. (2009)

mechanism.note: No mechanism term in the form Douglas summarises.

coefficients.needed: a1, a2, a3, a4, a6 and a7 on the published period grid. The appendix fixes a5 = 0.42 and confirms the 760 m/s boundary, but the remaining coefficients are explicitly NOT_REPRODUCED_IN_DOUGLAS.

implementation_notes: Magnitude-distance saturation through the a4*10^(a5*M) term.
Warn when used outside the Iran/west-Eurasia calibration context.

resolution_provenance.component: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): component code I50; OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/ghasemi_2009.py declares IMC.GMRotI50
resolution_provenance.internal_units: OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/ghasemi_2009.py: 'Original GMPE returns log10 acceleration in cm/s/s'. External implementation; Douglas does not state units.
resolution_provenance.periods.grid: OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/ghasemi_2009.py coefficient table; period count and range (17 periods, 0.05-3 s) match Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table). External implementation, original paper not checked.
